ui.description: MiniMax-H3 (Hailuo 3.0) generates video and synchronized stereo audio together in one pass — the clip arrives with its soundtrack already muxed, not dubbed on afterwards. Text-to-video plus first and/or last frame conditioning; there is no still-image mode, because the checkpoint refuses anything shorter than about five seconds. Clips come in fourteen fixed lengths between 5.17s and 14.38s at 24fps and nothing in between renders — including the 15s MiniMax's own documentation advertises, which is refused outright rather than quietly shortened to 14.38s. Optional Veda sparse attention uses the managed predictor and falls back to dense when it cannot run; the shortest dense clip at the default 1344x768 canvas is about a two-hour render, while the whole length range stays comfortable at 576x320. There is no guidance scale and no negative prompt — the model has neither axis, so those controls are hidden rather than missing. It renders through native MLX on Apple Silicon and Candle/CUDA on Windows and Linux; the measured q4, q8, and bf16 tiers require roughly 42 GB, 77 GB, and 69 GB of free VRAM respectively after the safety reserve.

ui.description: Few-step distilled RealVisXL — photoreal SDXL at ~5 steps, roughly 6x faster than the 30-step base. A standalone SDXL-Lightning checkpoint (openrail++, commercial-OK, ungated) tuned for the same photoreal look as RealVisXL_V5.0. Runs CFG-free by default (the negative prompt is inert unless you raise guidance toward 2.0). Text-to-image only; for edits, reference identity, masked inpaint, or detail-refine use the standard RealVisXL. Accepts sdxl-family LoRAs.

ui.description: NVIDIA SANA 1600M — an efficient Linear-DiT image model, ported natively to MLX on Apple Silicon and Candle on NVIDIA CUDA (Windows/Linux). Its 1.6B linear-attention transformer, deep-compression 32× DC-AE, and Gemma 2 instruction text encoder support text-to-image plus reference-guided image-to-image with true classifier-free guidance and negative prompts. Runs ~20 steps at guidance 4.5 (flow-match Euler, shift 3.0). Apple Silicon offers pre-packed q4 (default), q8, and bf16 tiers; Candle uses the original dense snapshot. The SANA transformer and VAE are licensed by NVIDIA under Apache-2.0; the bundled Gemma 2 text encoder is governed by Google's Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy.
ui.label: SANA 1600M

ui.description: NVIDIA SANA-Sprint 1.6B — the few-step SANA distillation, ported natively to MLX on Apple Silicon and Candle on NVIDIA CUDA (Windows/Linux). The same 1.6B linear-attention transformer, 32× DC-AE, and Gemma 2 instruction text encoder as base SANA support text-to-image plus reference-guided image-to-image. Its CFG-free SCM/TrigFlow sampler and guidance-embedding trunk generate a 1024×1024 image in about two steps with no negative prompt. Apple Silicon offers pre-packed q4 (default), q8, and bf16 tiers; Candle uses the original dense snapshot. The SANA transformer and VAE are licensed by NVIDIA under Apache-2.0; the bundled Gemma 2 text encoder is governed by Google's Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy.
ui.label: SANA-Sprint 1.6B

ui.description: zai-org SCAIL-2 character animation: give ordered reference character images and a driving video, and SCAIL-2 animates the supplied characters with the driving motion (the driving clip sets the motion and timing). Built on Wan2.1-14B; native MLX on macOS and native Candle on NVIDIA Windows/Linux admit the same installable q4, q8, and bf16 package variants when installed. ui.description: Stability AI Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large — the 8B multimodal diffusion transformer (MMDiT) flagship, running natively through MLX on Apple Silicon and Candle/CUDA on Windows/Linux. Triple text encoder (CLIP-L + CLIP-G + T5-XXL) for strong prompt adherence and in-image text; true classifier-free guidance with negative prompts. Runs ~28 steps at guidance 3.5 (flow-match Euler, shift 3.0); native 1024×1024. Pre-built and hosted by SceneWorks (Q4 default; Q8 + bf16 also available) — downloads ready-to-run with no install-time conversion or gated download. Runs through native MLX on Apple Silicon and native Candle/CUDA on Windows and Linux. Best for fast iteration at flagship quality; native 1024×1024. Runs CFG-free (the negative prompt is inert). ui.description: Stability AI Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium — the 2.5B MMDiT-X (dual-attention) mid-tier of the SD3.5 family, running natively through MLX on Apple Silicon and Candle/CUDA on Windows/Linux. Runs ~40 steps at guidance 4.5 (flow-match Euler, shift 3.0). Pre-built and hosted by SceneWorks (Q4 default; Q8 + bf16 also available) — downloads ready-to-run with no install-time conversion or gated download. memoryFloors.basis: Floors are GiB (2^30 bytes), judged against the device's capacity in GiB (a "96 GB" NVIDIA card is 95.59 GiB; an MLX floor is judged against unified memory minus the macOS/app reserve). Keyed by artifact and training resolution; `full_ac` is a full fine-tune under full activation checkpointing. Measured rows are the whole-process peak of a real full fine-tune at batch 1, converted to GiB, plus a 2 GiB reserve. MLX peaks are the ACTIVE peak with MLX's buffer cache disabled; production runs keep the cache, so a process footprint can rise to the allocator's GC ceiling (0.95 × the recommended working set) without that being need. Candle peaks are the live pool peak over six optimizer steps (steady from step 2) on a 95.59 GiB card; a row marked measured_spill is a need the run met only by spilling to system memory, so it does not fit that card. Each row carries its own provenance. Measured at the row's own shape: mlx full 512; mlx full 1024; mlx full_ac 1024; candle full 512; candle full_ac 512; candle full_ac 1024. Measured need that did not fit the measuring device (completed only by spilling to system memory): candle full 1024. Extrapolated from measured rows: mlx full 256; mlx full_ac 256; mlx full_ac 512; candle full 256; candle full_ac 256. Declared, not measured: mlx adapter 256; mlx adapter 512; mlx adapter 1024; candle adapter 256; candle adapter 512; candle adapter 1024. A machine under its floor is refused before the model loads, and a shape above the last row is refused rather than admitted without a bound.

ui.label: Iris 3B Depth
ui.description: Fine-tune Iris-3B monocular depth on aligned RGB + numerical depth (+ validity mask) examples — the paper's recipe (full fine-tune, masked L1 + gradient loss, AdamW 3e-5). Writes a depth model you can pick in the Image Editor and Library depth actions. Apple Silicon (MLX) and NVIDIA (Candle/CUDA).

Each row carries its own provenance. Measured at the row's own shape: mlx 262144; mlx 1048576; mlx full_ac 1048576; candle 262144; candle full_ac 1048576. Measured need that did not fit the measuring device (completed only by spilling to system memory): candle 1048576. Extrapolated from measured rows: mlx 16384; mlx 307200; mlx 589824; mlx full_ac 16384; mlx full_ac 262144; mlx full_ac 307200; mlx full_ac 589824; candle 307200; candle 589824; candle full_ac 262144; candle full_ac 307200; candle full_ac 589824. ui.label: Iris 3B Restoration
ui.description: Fine-tune Iris-3B restoration with the paper's adversarial recipe (pixel + LPIPS + ConvNeXt-critic GAN loss): a full fine-tune by default, or a LoRA / LoKr merged into the export. Train on clean images (reproducible synthetic degradation) or on aligned degraded/clean pairs. Writes a restoration model you can pick wherever Iris restores. Apple Silicon (MLX) and NVIDIA (Candle/CUDA).
